card.name: Space before a year or number digits
card.fires_on: Mostly the space just before a four-digit year (such as 1875 or 1898) in encyclopedia-style biography or date text, and sometimes a digit inside a year or ISBN.

modes.label: Space before a year
modes.description: A blank space right where a year's digits are about to start, in dates of artists or events.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit partway through a decade or ISBN number.

modes.label: Scattered other spots
modes.description: Occasional words in web text with no shared theme, such as after 'may'.

card.writes: It seems to push toward number-style continuations like year digits and away from quantity words such as hundred or thousand.
card.plain: It fires at the spot just before a year's digits, like 1875, in biographical text.
